Weehawken Diwali 2026 Indian Festival of Lights (Free Event)

About this Event

Join us for fun, food and Bollywood dancing. This non profit event celebrates the Festival of Lights in Weehawken.

Bollywood dance party and DJ, Indian food, Bhangra, henna, games, prizes and much more!!!

Celebrate Indian festival of lights with us.

Date: November 14th, 2026. From 5pm onwards.

F ree event (RSVP required)
Suggested donation $10 per person.
Venue: Roosevelt School

Theodare Roosevelt School
1 Louisa Pl,
Weehawken Township, NJ 07086

(For Weehawken residents only -- you can bring guests but at least one person in your group needs to have a Weehawken ID)
